description: Linter for AI slop across Markdown docs, HTML/CSS/JSX/SVG web UI, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), and PDF slides. Runs via pure-Markdown Agent Skills, offline Node/Python CLI, local stdio MCP, and Remote Cloud MCP.
rules: Run deterministic checks offline first with `npx --yes dislop check <path> --pack auto --format agent` (or `uvx dislop check ...`).
Verify edited drafts against the original or git HEAD with `npx --yes dislop verify --git HEAD <file> --strict` so no numbers, units, dates, or qualifiers are dropped.
For Remote MCP without local setup, connect to `https://dislop.com/mcp` (`dislop_check`, `dislop_verify`, and `dislop_rules` require 0 credits and no sign-in).
Use pure-Markdown Agent Skills via `npx --yes skills add dislop-ai/dislop --skill dislop` (or task-focused `deslop-docs`, `deslop-slides-docx`, `deslop-web-ui`, `deslop-verify`).
Only audit reader-facing text, web UI markup, and slides; skip pure code logic, unit tests, and lockfiles.
